planets.name: TOI-1279 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1279 with a 9.61-day year, found in 2024.

text.card: TOI-1279 b was found in 2024 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1279. Its orbit and size follow MacDougall et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
